#### HELA 850R Platinum / HELA 750R Platinum

### HELA Series

80 PLUS Platinum 850W / 750W PCIe 5 fully modular ATX PSU

▓ Support 12V-2x6 PCIe connector in compliance with ATX 3.1 standards ▓ High efficiency with 80 PLUS Platinum certification ▓ 100% modular cables ▓ 24/7 continuous power output with 50℃ operating temperature ▓ All Japanese capacitors ▓ Silent running 120mm Fluid Dynamic Bearing (FDB) cooling fan ▓ Equipped with sem-fanless switch function ▓ 180° angled SATA connectors, ideal for systems with a parallel hard drive layout.

## HELA 850R Platinum / HELA 750R Platinum SST-HA850R-PMA / SST-HA750R-PM

80 PLUS

850W / 750W

This specification defines ATX 12V Rev 3.1 multiple output switching power supply.. The parameters of this supply are defined in this specification for Family using. This specification defines max continuous output at 850W、750W with 90 to 264Vac input power supply ,with five outputs; +3.3V, +5V, +12V, -12V and +5VSB. The +5V standby voltage, remote on/off control, full range line input capability. An IEC connector is provided on the external face for AC input to the power supply. The power supply contains fans for cooling, while meeting acoustic requirements.

Title: HELA 850R Platinum
URL: https://www.silverstonetek.com/jp/press-release/hela_850r_platinum
Published: 2022-09-08T00:00:00.000Z
Author: SilverStone Technology
Highlights:
HELA 850R Platinum

SilverStone Officially Enters the Market with Its First ATX 3.0 Specification Compliant Power Supply

Taipei, Taiwan, 8th September 2022 –SilverStone Technology, an established leader in the PC component field, is thrilled to announce the immediate availability of the new HELA Series 850R Platinum power supply (PSU), offering the market with the first commercially available ATX 3.0 specification compliant Platinum efficiency rated power supply, while further broadening SilverStone’s already extensive and diverse PSU catalogue.

 Purchase link: https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0BDCKFCW4 HELA 850R Platinum is an ATX form factor fully modular unit with Cybenetics Platinum efficiency certification. At a depth of 150mm, HELA 850R Platinum’s packed with premium internal components such as all Japanese electrolytic capacitors, transistors, and transformers…etc; allowing the unit to punch out 850W of continuous power output. With rumors floating around that the Nvidia GeForce RTX 40-series graphics cards will be released in late 2022 - even though it’s simply a rumor, but for SilverStone, as a company on the forefront for power supplies, had begun vigorous testing at an early stage to meet the standards and requirements that are essential to the new GPU architecture - specifically, the ATX 3.0 specification; which signifies that the PSU will included a 12VHPWR (12-Volt High Power) interface with new 12+4-pin (16-pin) power connector(s) to provide greater reliability and power efficiency for the next generation of PCIe Gen5 graphics cards. HELA 850R Platinum will include 1 x 12VHPWR connector cable constructed using copper alloy and 16AWG wire gauge, capable of providing up to 450W of power.
